Source: [pkg/state/doc.go](https://github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/blob/main/pkg/state/doc.go).

Package state is AgentShield's PostgreSQL store: contribution publication, the current graph, the change feed, findings, detection signals, the investigation queue, and detector persistence.

## Pipeline position {#hdr-Pipeline_position}

Discovery plugins and the telemetry rollup produce complete contributions. [Store.ReplaceContribution](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Store.ReplaceContribution) validates each one with the graph compiler and publishes it in one transaction. Publication appends to a transactional outbox that the detection service reads with [Store.ReadContributionChanges](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Store.ReadContributionChanges) and [Store.ReadGraphCheckpoint](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Store.ReadGraphCheckpoint); detection then records [DetectionSignal](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#DetectionSignal) values and rule [Finding](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Finding) values, enqueues investigation jobs, and advances a [ReasoningCursor](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#ReasoningCursor). The investigation worker claims and admits jobs ([Store.ClaimInvestigationJob](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Store.ClaimInvestigationJob), [Store.AdmitInvestigationJob](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Store.AdmitInvestigationJob)) and records agentic findings. Detector rulesets, Deployment rule-authoring jobs, and their review status ([Store.ReadWorkloadRules](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Store.ReadWorkloadRules)) are stored here as well.

## Contributions and generations {#hdr-Contributions_and_generations}

A [Contribution](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Contribution) is the complete assertion set owned by one (plugin, source, name) tuple. Each publication is a new generation; assertions omitted from it are retracted. Generations must increase: an older generation is rejected, the same generation with the same input digest is an idempotent retry, and the same generation with a different digest is an error. [Store.ContributionGeneration](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Store.ContributionGeneration) lets a restarted plugin resume above its last durable generation.

## Publication {#hdr-Publication}

Publication builds a complete candidate from the revision-validated in-memory graph, then uses a compare-and-swap transaction to persist content-addressed assertions, advance the contribution head, update active membership and affected projection rows, and append at most one outbox event. Readers never see a partially published contribution.

## Change feed {#hdr-Change_feed}

Each outbox event carries a monotonic sequence and the non-telemetry assertions added and retracted by one contribution version. Telemetry-only publications that do not change readiness, health, or status are committed without an outbox event, so telemetry cadence does not drive detection.

## Reads {#hdr-Reads}

[Store.Latest](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Store.Latest) and [Store.ReadGraphCheckpoint](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Store.ReadGraphCheckpoint) read the active assertion union inside a repeatable-read transaction and compile it after the transaction ends, so the returned graph and its SHA-256 are coherent with each other and with the checkpoint sequence. [Store.CreateManifest](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/state#Store.CreateManifest) pins the active contribution versions for reproducible analysis.

Schema files are embedded and verified by checksum at startup. Until the first release, baseline changes require recreating the database.

See docs/architecture/publication-and-storage.md and docs/concepts/data-model.md.
